title: A planner built for your brain
body: Never found one that works for you? Tell us how your brain actually likes to work — and we'll build a printable planner from your answers, with your name on the cover. £10, made to order.
caption:
Every planner assumes you're someone else. 🐸

We kept hearing the same thing from you: "I've never found a planner that works for me."

So we made one that starts with you instead. Answer nine questions about how your brain actually works — time blocks or a short list, spoons or a battery, whether starting things is the hard part — and we'll build a printable planner from your answers. Your name on the cover. Undated on purpose, so a skipped day never ruins it. Print it as many times as you like, forever.

£10, made to order 🐸 forms.gle/GJjQ8rMSoqh7ffPx5 (also in bio)
